news.title: Mbappe's Brace Powers Real Madrid To Victory Against Sevilla
news.description: Kylian Mbappe scored two goals to lead Real Madrid to a convincing 4-1 victory over Sevilla, narrowing the gap on LaLiga leaders Barcelona to six points ahead of their crucial upcoming encounter.

news.title: Mutual fund inflows insufficient to lift markets: Manish Jain, Choice MF
news.description: Manish Jain, Deputy CEO of Choice Mutual Fund has said that mutual fund inflows are not sufficient to lift the market alone. He added that domestic money sets the floor only, and not the ceiling.
